title: Home Visit Planner
description: Home Visit Planner is a web-based application designed to help families and schools efficiently plan and manage home visits. It allows families to create, edit, and view their own visit schedules, while also providing access to other families’ schedules for better coordination. Teachers and administrators can optimize routes, assign visits based on class and location, and ensure a balanced workload for staff. The system features an interactive map that displays all student addresses as markers, with detailed information available on click, and a control panel for adjusting routes and schedules. Built with Flask and MySQL, the platform combines a robust backend, a user-friendly frontend, and optimized algorithms for route planning. This project demonstrates how thoughtful technology can save time, reduce errors, and improve communication in school visit programs, making the process more efficient and accessible for everyone involved.
